about.title: About & Download
about.description: What {brand} is and how to use it; download all HD posters and the dataset; CC BY 4.0 attribution guide.
about.lead: 350 layout and composition reference posters, each covering one technique: what it is, its key points, and when to use it. Organized across {cats} categories and {subs} themes — searchable, downloadable, and ready to use in your prompts.
about.how1: In the Atlas, click a category tab or type into the search bar to the right — search by name, number, English title, key points, or keywords. Open Display to switch to poster wall or list view and adjust columns per row.
about.how2: Click any poster to view it large, or click the image for actual size so every small caption stays legible. Switch versions where a second edition is available.
about.how3: Download HD (WebP, 1086 × 1448), or Copy Composition Prompt — a concise paragraph describing the layout that you can append to your image prompt.
about.how4: Favorite candidate layouts while working on a project, then open Favorites in the Atlas to copy your shortlist (number + name) in one click. Favorites are stored only in this browser.
about.zip: All 350 HD Posters (ZIP): original PNGs attached to the GitHub Release.
about.zip100: Classic 100 Edition (ZIP): the original “100 Layouts” set.
about.data: Dataset: CSV (opens directly in spreadsheets) · JSON (for programmatic use). Fields include number, name, category, theme, image path, dimensions, and SHA-256.
about.licenseText: Images and data are licensed under CC BY 4.0: free to share, adapt, and use commercially, as long as you give credit and indicate if changes were made. Suggested attribution:
about.textBody: The definitions, key points, usage notes, and keywords on detail pages were transcribed directly from the posters: two models transcribed each poster independently, fields were compared line by line, and any discrepancies were verified by hand — strictly transcribed, never extrapolated. Spot a mistake? Report it on GitHub Issues.
about.translated: The interface and poster text in this language were translated from Chinese by AI; the poster images themselves remain in Chinese. If anything reads wrong, please report it on GitHub Issues.
